About me

Who is building this

I am in the final semester of Electronics and Telecommunications at Gdańsk University of Technology. I build applications and automation tools: API integrations, data flows and the glue between modules.

My habit is to break a problem down like a tree. One root, then categories, subcategories and the connections between them, until every leaf is something I can build and test. Automation is just that habit applied to my own work: if I do something three times, it becomes a tool.

Outside code: geography, blending music, the gym, AI audio-separation tools and first steps in architectural visualisation with ComfyUI.

  • Tutoring. High-school maths with diagrams and analogies that fit the student.

How I build with AI

I use Claude Code and Codex every day for implementation. What stays with me is the part that decides whether a tool works: what to build, how it splits into modules, what data passes between them, and whether it holds up in real use. JobManager and this site were built this way.

  1. 1Define

    The problem, who uses it and what done looks like.

  2. 2Decompose

    Modules, data contracts and interfaces, written down before code.

  3. 3Direct

    AI writes code against that plan, one module at a time. I review and connect it.

  4. 4Verify

    Run it on real data, read the failures, fix the plan, repeat.
